data.name: Sahadev
data.gender_notes: Sahadev is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: With the gods; a Pandava's name
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saha, 'with', + deva, 'god' — 'with the gods'. Its root is Sanskrit saha + deva. Sahadeva, one of the Pandavas in the Mahabharata. Sahadev is a Sanskrit name meaning “With the gods; a Pandava's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sahadev expresses “With the gods; a Pandava's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit saha, 'with', + deva, 'god' — 'with the gods'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahadev total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
